t: Took its present form in 1839, when William I accepted Belgian independence; the 1848 constitution established parliamentary government.
Its wealth long rested on the Dutch East Indies, exploited under the cultivation system and lost when Indonesia won independence in 1949.
Occupied by Germany in 1940–45, it became a founding member of NATO and the European Communities and a centre of international law.
dyk: Since 2010 the Kingdom of the Netherlands has consisted of four countries, the Netherlands, Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, while Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are special Dutch municipalities.
ev: William I recognises Belgian independence in the Treaty of London
Thorbecke’s constitutional revision introduces ministerial responsibility
Multatuli’s Max Havelaar attacks colonial exploitation in Java
The Pacification brings universal male suffrage and equal funding for schools
Germany invades; Rotterdam is bombed and the army capitulates within five days
Sovereignty over Indonesia is transferred to the new Indonesian state
The North Sea flood kills 1,836 people and leads to the Delta Works
The Treaty of Maastricht creating the European Union is signed
